limits: Only headless, and no HUD: the playable HUD is V05-05; no capture exists or is claimed.
The presses of the consumer are synthetic: mouse events pushed into the viewport by validation.gd (End turn and Menu in the same frame both go in before a frame passes), not a person on a window.
The calls made while a job runs and the 150 extra subscribers are probe fixtures; the stress cases are a measure of the registry's budgets, not a policy for backlog.
finished_jobs is bounded to the last 256 jobs; the probe and the ten cycles stay far below that (15 and 20 jobs).
new_game abandons a job in progress: nothing finishes it and no turn_ended fires for it. There is no cancel method, and a job does not survive a new application (D22 and D23 are pending).
The job follows the game's clock: it stops while the tree is paused.
The rule lane mutates one constant (the Settler's movement points, 2 to 0) and compares what JavaScript received; it does not mutate other rules.
The probe measures the registry's pump per frame; the game's own tasks and events in turn_ended.phases are a different count and are kept apart.
Hosted CI and the Pages publication are pending.
